variables.physical_definition: the first-order absolute moment of height fluctuations
the peak-to-valley height
the root-mean-square height
the third central moment of roughness height fluctuations divided by the cube of their root-mean-square height
the kurtosis of roughness height fluctuations
the effective streamwise slope of the roughness
the surface porosity

result.basis_precision_note: basis_matrices stores full floating-point precision; basis_matrices_display is rounded for display only.
